content-atomizer.alt: Content atomizer: receive an article, draft three formats, review the drafts, then publish approved versions.

voice-production.alt: Narration workflow: prepare a script and authorized voice, generate a short sample, review pronunciation and delivery, then export approved audio.
voice-production.caption: Review a short sample before generating the complete narration. The diagram describes a workflow; it makes no latency or quality benchmark claim.

higgsfield-three-shot-stop-rule.alt: Three shots and one stop rule: arrival wide view, preparation contact view, decision close push, and concrete rejection conditions before rendering another clip.
higgsfield-three-shot-stop-rule.caption: The three-shot acceptance workflow and stop rule. Verify geometry and contact, and accept the face only when it still matches the reference.

elevenlabs-journal-audio-briefing.alt: Four-step founder journal to consent-based audio briefing pipeline: public journal note and character ceiling, voice-owner consent and allowlist check, idempotent ElevenLabs synthesis, and MP3 frame QA with provenance manifest.

proof-toolkit-layers.alt: Your AI crew in three layers: prompts help you think, skills make your process consistent, MCP connects real tools such as GitHub, notes and deploy. You approve every send, merge and publish.

founder-agent-swarm-decision-map.alt: Three ways to hand off agent work. Antigravity receives independent tasks and returns worker diffs for integration testing. Replit receives a goal and cap and returns a demo and evaluation. Board receives tasks for existing agents and records handoff evidence. The founder reproduces checks, tracks time, spend or quota, and rework.

bf2026-studio-hero.prompt: A cinematic wide 16:9 film still of a quiet working studio in an old canal house at blue hour. On a long, worn oak worktable stand exactly two instruments facing each other: on the right, a compact cinema camera on a short tripod; beside it, a large-diaphragm studio microphone on a desk stand with its cable trailing across the wood. Between them lie a closed black notebook, a pencil and a ceramic mug. One small warm tungsten desk lamp is the only practical light, pooling amber on the table; the rest of the room falls into deep navy and slate shadow, never pure black. A tall window at the far right shows soft out-of-focus lights reflected on canal water. Composition: the instruments and lamp occupy the right 55 percent of the frame; the left 45 percent is an uncluttered, softly textured dark plaster wall with gentle falloff, left empty for a headline. Low eye-level camera, 40mm lens, shallow depth of field, restrained documentary realism, muted cinematic grade, fine 35mm film grain. The scene contains no people, no screens, no glowing lines, no holograms, no floating graphics, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand markings on any object.
